jana2014_in_out — add (read/write):
// read two numbers; write their sum and the second (write consumes the value,
// so the store ends clean).  Backward run subtracts.
procedure main()
    int x
    int y
    read x
    read y
    x += y
    write x
    write y
jana2014_in_out — swap (read/write):
// reversible swap over read/write I/O; the store ends clean
procedure main()
    int x
    int y
    read x
    read y
    x <=> y
    write x
    write y
